grizzly.summary: A containerized air-defense launcher for DCS World.
facts: Medium/large drones, helicopters and low, slow aircraft
notes: Close DCS and extract the TPG Containerized SHORAD folder into your active Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/ folder. The resulting mod folder must contain entry.lua. Restart DCS after installation.

In Mission Editor, find TPG Containerized SHORAD in Air Defence. Place it on clear, level ground with an unobstructed view of the intended engagement area; choose the default, Woodland or Sand appearance using Paint Scheme.
The launcher carries eight missiles, has four missile channels, a ten-second shot interval and an 18-minute reload. Stop the launcher to fire.
Detection range is 12 km. Place the launcher with a clear view of approaching targets.

The 1.2–9 km firing band and 12 km detection range are separate limits. The files also contain a 10,000 m target-altitude gate; that is a targeting filter, not a demonstrated 10 km engagement ceiling. Both range and altitude restrictions apply to a shot. High or distant targets may be detected without being reachable.
payloadNotes: The custom interceptor uses an explosive anti-aircraft warhead with a 15 kg explosive setting and a 15 m detonation distance. The eight ready missiles are for local air defence.

paragraphs: TPG Containerized SHORAD is a custom launcher. Comparable real systems protect troops and fixed sites by combining sensors with short-range weapons.

MBDA introduced Sky Warden in 2021. It brings radar, cameras and other sensors together with electronic countermeasures and weapons, and can be mounted on a vehicle or deployed on the ground. It is a useful real-world comparison for the role of this mod.

v2.summary: V-2 rocket with static launch bases, Sd.Kfz. 7 towed launchers and a custom ballistic flight profile, in camouflaged and black/white variants.
notes: Close DCS and copy TPG V2 into Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/, then restart DCS. The mod includes Camo Static, Black/White Static, Sd.Kfz. 7 Towed – Camo and Sd.Kfz. 7 Towed – Black/White units.

Place one launcher per group. At the firing waypoint, stop on clear, level ground and add Advanced Waypoint Actions → Perform Task → Fire at Point. Choose a target 50–300 km away and set expenditure to one round. Each launcher carries one rocket and does not reload.

For towed units, use Alarm State Green and a nonzero speed at the first waypoint to travel. At the firing waypoint, stop and set Alarm State Red. The supports deploy, the rocket rises and the truck pulls the trailer clear of the launch base. Preparation from stowed takes about three minutes. Alarm State controls deployment; ROE controls permission to fire.

The custom trajectory and aiming data give short, medium and long shots different arcs rather than reusing one fixed flight path. The supplied plot shows three examples: about 33, 103 and 162 nautical miles, with apogees of roughly 85,000, 198,000 and 288,000 ft. Long shots rise to about 88 km and approach Mach 3.5 near impact.
Historical scatter is built in: individual rockets can miss by several kilometres. Use it for area bombardment. Native AI stows the launcher after the task; Green reverses deployment for travel.
payloadNotes: The DCS rocket has a 1,000 kg warhead assembly, including 910 kg of explosive and a 90 kg piercing component. It is a conventional high-explosive weapon with substantial area effects.

paragraphs: Developed in Germany as the A4, the V-2 entered combat in September 1944. It used a liquid-fuel rocket engine and gyroscopic guidance, climbing high before falling onto its target at supersonic speed. London and Antwerp were major targets.

Its poor accuracy made it an area weapon. Production relied on concentration-camp forced labour at Mittelbau-Dora. After the war, captured rockets and German engineers contributed to American and Soviet missile and space programs.

detailGallery.caption: TPG V-2 trajectory plot: short, medium and long shots from a common launch point, with distance in nautical miles and altitude in feet

12-pounder-cannon.summary: Separate Cannonball and Lavaball units with automatic enemy engagement and optional Combined Arms control.
facts: Exposed troops, unarmored vehicles and light structures
notes: Close DCS and copy TPG_12_Pounder_Cannon into Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/, then restart DCS. In Mission Editor, select Artillery and choose TPG 12 Pounder Cannon – Cannonball or TPG 12 Pounder Cannon – Lavaball.
The unit automatically engages enemies it detects inside its firing range and detection envelope, when ROE and Alarm State permit. Use an unobstructed line of sight and stop the unit to fire.
Engagement range is 30 m–2.4 km. Each unit carries 20 rounds of its selected ammunition, fires at 30-second intervals and has a ten-minute reload setting.
Direct control requires Combined Arms and mission or server permission. For multiplayer, the server and clients need the mod.
payloadNotes: Cannonball is solid iron round shot with no explosive filling. The projectile’s damage comes from impact. Its round-shot mass is about 5.44 kg (12 lb), and launch velocity is 300 m/s.
Lavaball is a fictional ammunition option with a glowing model and a 0.8 kg explosive setting. It shares the cannonball’s basic flight setup.

paragraphs: Smoothbore guns were commonly named for the weight of the solid iron ball they fired. A 12-pounder fired a ball of about twelve pounds; the name covered many gun designs rather than one particular model.
Solid shot battered structures and struck targets by impact. Historical guns also used other ammunition, including explosive shell and canister. The Lavaball is a fictional addition for DCS.

items: Added the ability for the unit to self-engage enemies within its firing range and detection envelopes. Script hook no longer required.

apkws-vshorad.summary: A stationary 16-round APKWS turret with separate near and far ammunition banks and optical sensors.
facts: Drones, helicopters and low, slow aircraft
notes: Install the TPG APKWS VSHORAD folder into the active Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/ profile and restart DCS. Keep one installed copy. Find TPG APKWS VSHORAD in the Air Defence category and choose a Paint Scheme.

The two launch banks have different launch angles and eight rounds each. Their engagement bands are 1,000-3,000 m and 3,001-4,500 m. FAR rounds can intercept closer targets while NEAR rounds can wait for a distant target to approach.
The optical and infrared system guides 70 mm rockets with a laser. Place it on clear, level ground with an unobstructed view of the target.
Full azimuth rotation, elevation from -30 to +85 degrees, traverse at 120 degrees/second and elevation at 90 degrees/second. Shot delay is two seconds; reload takes five minutes.
The M151-type warhead carries 1.04 kg of explosive per rocket. Keep Config.lua installed and restart DCS after configuration changes.
payloadNotes: Each 70 mm rocket uses an M151-type high-explosive fragmentation warhead with 1.04 kg of explosive in the mod. Laser guidance steers the rocket onto the target; each of the two launch banks holds eight rounds.

paragraphs: APKWS adds a laser-guidance section to a standard 70 mm rocket. It was developed for precision attacks from aircraft and has since been adapted to ground and maritime launchers.

L3Harris began field-testing VAMPIRE in 2021 and received a contract in January 2023 to supply systems for Ukraine. VAMPIRE combines a camera and laser designator with guided rockets for counter-drone and ground-target missions. The TPG turret uses its own stationary 16-round layout.

sahin-cuas.summary: A stationary Mk19-based counter-drone system using a dedicated reduced-dispersion M430 test round.
facts: Slow drones and low, slow helicopters at close range
notes: Close DCS and copy TPG_SAHIN_CUAS into Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/, then restart DCS. Use the corresponding Saved Games profile if yours has a different name.
Use it against slower drones and low, slow helicopters at close range. Keep a clear view between the gun and the target. The 10 km detection range is separate from its 600 m firing range.
The gun carries 192 rounds in 64-round portions and fires at about 261 rounds per minute. This alpha uses a reduced-dispersion M430 test round.
payloadNotes: The mod uses a 40 mm M430 HEDP-based test round weighing 0.248 kg, with a 0.1 kg explosive setting and a shaped-charge damage component. Its direct-hit/timed-expiry setup differs from the programmable ATOM airburst ammunition used by the real ŞAHİN.

paragraphs: ASELSAN developed ŞAHİN as a close-range counter-drone gun system. It uses automatic target detection and tracking with 40 mm programmable ATOM airburst grenades to engage small drones.

akinci.summary: An AI Akıncı-C with nine attachment stations, EO/IR sensors and multirole radar.

fps-132.summary: A fixed radar facility for scenery and target infrastructure.
facts: No active detection in this package
notes: An unarmed static structure with collision geometry for the housing, berm, buildings and plinth.

anduril-rail.summary: A stationary rail for GPS and anti-ship ALTIUS-700M variants, using native DCS weapon guidance.
notes: Place the launcher with a clear flight path, allowing room for the drone to climb.

fp1-drone.summary: A native DCS guided weapon with a separate launch rail and a belly booster shown on the loaded drone.
notes: Allow a clear departure path and plan the route around terrain and obstacles.

shahed-238.summary: Ground-launched Shahed-238 drones with separate GPS and anti-ship launchers, each carrying up to five shots.
notes: Close DCS and extract TPG_Shahed238_Rail into your active Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/ folder, then restart DCS. The installed folder must contain entry.lua.

In Mission Editor, find TPG Shahed-238 GPS and TPG Shahed-238 ASM under Artillery. Both launchers are stationary, show one drone on the rail and carry up to five shots. Reduce ammunition in Mission Editor if desired. Choose Original Green or Sand Tan in Paint Scheme.
GPS: add Advanced Waypoint Actions → Perform Task → Fire at Point and select the ground target. The drone follows the assigned point-target mission.

ASM means anti-ship missile. Use Fire at Point to send the ASM drone toward a chosen point at sea. If it passes within 8 km of an enemy ship and its seeker detects the ship, it turns to attack. If it finds no ship, it continues toward the assigned point. The 8 km figure is the search limit, so a ship also has to be visible to the seeker and inside its forward search area.
Launch range is 20–1,000 km, cruise speed is 500 km/h and cruise height is 300 m. Plan the flight path around terrain, trees and buildings. Shot delay and reload time are both ten minutes.
payloadNotes: Both DCS variants carry a 50 kg warhead with 25 kg of explosive and a 25 kg piercing component. The drone weighs 370 kg and has a Mach 0.50 speed limit.

paragraphs: Iran unveiled the Shahed-238 in 2023 as a jet-powered development of the propeller-driven Shahed-136. It keeps the delta-wing layout but uses a small turbojet for faster flight.
The family includes versions with different guidance systems. The related Russian jet-powered version is known as Geran-3.

items: Fixed: the drone could not be tracked by IR-seeking air-to-air missiles.
Fixed: cannon and gun projectiles passed through the drone body.

t34-calliope.summary: A 60-tube Calliope with automatic enemy engagement, custom M8 rockets, Combined Arms control and detailed vehicle animation.
facts: Troop concentrations, soft vehicles and area targets
notes: Install T34 Calliope in Saved Games/DCS/Mods/tech/ and restart DCS. Find TPG T34 Calliope (M4 Sherman) under Artillery; available to all countries and coalitions.

The unit automatically engages enemies it detects inside its firing range and detection envelope when ROE and Alarm State permit. Keep its line of sight clear and stop before firing rockets; the machine guns can fire while moving.

Enable Combined Arms vehicle control in the mission. Default bindings: Q selects the main turret, E cycles its weapons, and Space fires. Stop for rocket fire; both M1919 machine guns support unstabilized fire on the move. The original launcher-fitted configuration keeps the cannon disabled.

The M8 uses its own model, ammunition and conventional 4.3 lb TNT warhead. All 60 tube launch points fire sequentially. Slow visual roll and randomized launch disturbance produce a wider area-fire pattern with more side-to-side variation.
The rocket sight uses the native MLRS range controller with this M8 ammunition. Coaxial and bow guns have separate ammunition stores, 250-round belts, firing loops and burst-tail audio.

Custom work includes articulated launcher linkage, flexible wiring, circulating track shoes, rotating wheels, animated suspension and dim amber headlights. Fourteen 2K material sets add varied wear and suspension-matched hull dirt.
Dedicated thermal maps distinguish engine, running gear, weapon and body response. Thirty-two armor zones include the visible applique plates. Tank, wreck and rocket each have four distance LODs.

Rebuilt destroyed model with a detailed exposed radial engine, a creased gun barrel, a broken track laid ahead of the hull, scattered damaged rocket tubes and torn steel fragments. Dedicated 2K/4K wreck textures add varied charring, ash, impact pitting and spall scars.
Original model by OK3D; DCS integration and custom material work by TPG. The download includes the full installation and feature guide.

detailGallery.caption: Research reference: OS 9-69, Rockets and Launchers, February 1944

payloadNotes: Each 4.5-inch M8 rocket weighs about 17.28 kg and carries 4.3 lb (1.95 kg) of TNT in a conventional high-explosive/fragmentation warhead. The full 60-rocket salvo is suited to area targets. The coaxial and bow M1919 machine guns use separate .30-06 ball and tracer ammunition.

paragraphs: The U.S. Army mounted the T34 rocket launcher on the M4 Sherman during the Second World War. Its sixty tubes fired 4.5-inch M8 rockets in a rapid salvo, adding area firepower to an armored unit.
Tank-mounted rocket launchers were being produced in greater numbers by 1944. The original Calliope used a linkage to the Sherman’s gun barrel to elevate the rocket rack, as represented in this mod.

references.label: U.S. Army: wartime tank-mounted rocket launchers

items: Adjusted rocket scatter to better approximate historical lack of accuracy.
Added the ability for the unit to self-engage enemies within its firing range and detection envelopes.
Rebuilt the destroyed model with an exposed radial engine, creased barrel, ground-laid broken track, scattered launcher tubes and detailed torn-metal fragments.
Added 2K/4K charred wreck textures, impact pitting and spall scars; replaced the destroyed-model profile series.
